name: etymology
title: Etymology
description: Trace where a word comes from, one ancestor at a time, using Wiktionary's etymology data.
author: zak_katz

commands.name: search-etymology
commands.title: Search Etymology
commands.description: Look up a word and walk its chain of ancestors

commands.name: lookup-selection
commands.title: Look up Selection
